height_source.discrepancy_note: Raster rooftop median and upper-tail heights exceed the current roof slab and penthouse coping top. The broad polygon statistic does not assign the discrepancy to a particular wall, floor, penthouse surface, or mast. No story spacing or individual roof component was changed.
height_source.limits: 5-ft DSM first-surface cells and 2.5-ft bare-earth DTM; height difference is approximate, with no local survey points or verified vertical-datum metadata. Footprint includes passage/edges and DSM includes roof equipment/returns. This does not establish exact parapet, mast, penthouse edges, or floor-by-floor elevations.

interior_access.public_plan_limitation: The Purdue Building Deputy manual says construction plans are available through a facilities request and floor plans through Purdue's FM:S access; it also says these plans should not be copied or redistributed. No current as-built third-floor plan was accessed. R10 preserves the schematic partitions, circulation, stair geometry, and furniture placement.
